symptom: `alter page … set (Image: 'M.Images.gear') on staticImage12` was refused with `property "Image" is not a property of this built-in widget` although CREATE writes `Image:` and DESCRIBE prints it; same for `DefaultImage:` on a dynamic image (mendixlabs/mxcli#1464).
cause: setRawWidgetPropertyMut had no image/defaultimage case, so the key fell through to the pluggable setter, which fails at noPluggableObjectError on any built-in widget.
insight: **Every property CREATE gained for a built-in widget (#1057 Image, #1307 Tooltip, #1228 RenderMode) is a SET gap until the mutator switch learns it** — grep the CREATE builder's GetStringProp keys for the widget and diff against setRawWidgetPropertyMut. Guard on the stored $Type, not the key: `image` is also a plausible pluggable template key, and the pluggable Image keeps its own path. Making SET accept a reference also makes it the one place a reference skips `check --references` — the dry run only proves the key is writable, so resolve the written name too (reuse the CREATE resolver, which carries the same-script exemption #1419).
